scripts.title: INF Stamina
scripts.script:
-- G = Unlimited Stamina, T = Power Tackle

pcall(function() loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://scriptblox.com/ingest/clientv2.lua"))("proj_64f97f78a5b9", "1.0.0", false) end) -- Analytics


local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local staminaEnabled = false
local tackleEnabled = false

local SlideTackleMod = nil
local TackBack = nil

pcall(function()
    SlideTackleMod = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Actions.SlideTackle)
    if SlideTackleMod and SlideTackleMod.Constants then
        TackBack = table.clone(SlideTackleMod.Constants)
    end
end)

-- INF Stamina
local updateSprint = filtergc("function", {Name = "updateSprint"}, true)
local module = debug.getupvalue(updateSprint, 14)
local Update = module.Update

local oldUpdate
oldUpdate = hookfunction(Update, function(...)
    local data = select(2, ...)

    if staminaEnabled and data and rawget(data, "HasUnlimitedStamina") ~= nil then
        rawset(data, "HasUnlimitedStamina", true)
    end

    return oldUpdate(...)
end)

-- Power Tackle
local function applyTacklePower()
    pcall(function()
        if SlideTackleMod and SlideTackleMod.Constants and TackBack then
            local mult = tackleEnabled and 1.6 or 1 --- 1.6 is the tackle power multiplier, change this to your liking
            for k,v in pairs(TackBack) do
                if typeof(v) == "number" then
                    if k == "Distance" or k == "StartupDashDistance" or k == "BallKnockSpeed" then
                        SlideTackleMod.Constants[k] = v * mult
                    elseif k == "StaminaCost" and tackleEnabled then
                        SlideTackleMod.Constants[k] = 0
                    else
                        SlideTackleMod.Constants[k] = v
                    end
                else
                    SlideTackleMod.Constants[k] = v
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.G then
        staminaEnabled = not staminaEnabled

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then
        tackleEnabled = not tackleEnabled
        applyTacklePower()

    end
end)

applyTacklePower()
print("Loaded | G = Unlimited Stamina | T = Power Tackle")

scripts.title: Axon Hub | Perfect Shot, Auto Keeper & Infinite Stamina
scripts.features:
Axon Hub for Illegal Soccer brings together Perfect Shot, Auto Keeper, Auto Tackle, Infinite Stamina, weapon aiming tools, and customizable ESP. Configure shooting, defending, movement, and visuals from one interface.

SHOOTING & BALL CONTROL
• Perfect Shot — redirects your charged shots toward a top corner without moving your camera.
• Choose a corner away from the goalkeeper or use random corner targeting.
• Optional goal-zone restriction for Perfect Shot.
• Auto Volley — performs a sombrero, jump, and fully charged shot combo inside your configured goal area.
• Adjustable volley range and a dedicated activation keybind.
• Auto Sombrero — activates when another player approaches, with adjustable distance and continuous activation options.
• Sombrero Cooldown Bypass.

GOALKEEPER & DEFENDING
• Auto Keeper — tracks incoming shots along the goal line while you are playing goalkeeper.
• Auto Dive — reacts to shots coming toward you.
• Auto Tackle — targets the opponent carrying the ball or the nearest enemy within range.
• Adjustable tackle distance and team filtering.

ITEMS & WEAPON AIMING
• Auto Use Item — automatically equips and activates available items.
• Shotgun and Flintlock targeting for the nearest enemy or enemy carrying the ball.
• Aimbot with an adjustable field of view, activation keybind, and team check.
• Silent Aim for Shotgun and Flintlock.
• Configurable aiming circles.

PLAYER, BALL & ITEM ESP
• Player boxes, names, distances, tracers, and chams.
• Ball-carrier and stun indicators.
• Separate teammate and enemy colors.
• Ball tracers, chams, and distance display.
• Item names, distances, chams, and item filtering.
• Adjustable ESP distance and colors.

MOVEMENT & EXTRAS
• Infinite Stamina.
• Anti Ragdoll.
• Adjustable Walkspeed.
• Fly with adjustable speed.
• Anti AFK.
• Auto Roll with optional notifications.
• Automatic team selection with a preferred-team setting.
• Disable goal and victory cameras.
• Visual range indicators for tackles, sombreros, volleys, and Perfect Shot.

Discord: discord.gg/axonhub
Supported games: https://axon.getxenith.cc/home
